# 7 Best Background Verification Software in India for 2026


September 15, 2026


[Shashank Yadav](https://salarybox.in/blog/author/shashank87cc9f270b/)


[No comments yet](https://salarybox.in/blog/7-best-background-verification-software-in-india-for-2026/#respond)


Hiring someone without verifying their background is like signing a cheque without looking at the amount. You might get lucky. Or you might discover, three months into the relationship, that the person you hired never attended the university on their resume, never worked at the company they claimed four years at, or carries a criminal record they conveniently forgot to mention.


The problem is not awareness. Most HR teams in India know they should be running background checks. The problem is execution. Traditional BGV used to mean signing a contract with a verification agency, paying retainer fees, waiting 15 to 20 days for results, and chasing vendors through email threads that never seem to end. In 2026, that model is dying. A new generation of digital-first verification platforms has made it possible to verify a candidate’s PAN, Aadhaar, employment history, and education in minutes rather than weeks, often without speaking to a single salesperson.


We evaluated the leading background verification software available in India right now, comparing them on what actually matters: speed of results, range of checks, pricing transparency, ease of use, and whether they require you to sit through a demo before you can run your first check.


Here are the seven platforms that stood out.


## 1. Compose1 Verify


**Best for:** Self-serve identity and employment verification with zero friction


**Website:**[https://compose1.com/verify/](https://compose1.com/verify/)


Compose1 Verify sits at the top of this list because it solves the single biggest problem with background verification in India: you should not need a contract, a sales call, or a minimum volume commitment to verify whether a candidate is who they say they are.


The platform offers PAN verification, Aadhaar verification, Voter ID checks, Driving Licence verification, UAN-based employment history checks, and address verification, all from a single self-serve dashboard. You create an account, enter the candidate’s details, select the checks you need, and get government-database-verified results in minutes. There is no demo to schedule, no contract to negotiate, and no minimum number of checks to commit to.


What makes Compose1 genuinely different from the enterprise BGV platforms on this list is the cross-record confidence analysis. When you run multiple checks on the same candidate, the platform automatically compares names, dates of birth, and other identity signals across all returned records and flags inconsistencies. If the PAN database returns one date of birth and the Voter ID returns a different one, you know immediately. This catches composite identity fraud that document-by-document verification misses entirely.


The UAN verification is particularly valuable. Instead of calling previous employers and waiting days for a response, Compose1 pulls the candidate’s employment history directly from EPFO records — employer names, contribution dates, and amounts. It is faster, more reliable, and impossible for the candidate to manipulate.


Every verification generates a downloadable PDF report suitable for HR files and compliance audits. Pay-per-check pricing means you pay only for the checks you run. There are no subscriptions, no retainers, and no hidden fees.


**Checks offered:** PAN, Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving Licence, UAN/employment history, address verification, cross-record analysis


**Turnaround:** Minutes for identity checks; same day for most others


**Pricing model:** Pay per check, no contracts, no minimums


**Ideal for:** SMEs, startups, individual landlords, PG operators, and any HR team that values speed and cost transparency


## 2. SalaryBox


**Best for:** All-in-one HRMS with natively integrated background verification


**Website:**[salarybox.in](https://salarybox.in/)


If Compose1 is the answer when you need a standalone verification tool, SalaryBox is the answer when you want verification built into the same system where your attendance, payroll, and employee records already live.


SalaryBox is India’s most widely used attendance and payroll app, trusted by thousands of businesses for daily workforce management. The platform combines biometric attendance tracking, GPS-based check-ins, facial recognition for proxy prevention, automated payroll calculation, salary slip generation, leave management, shift scheduling, and a full HRMS — all in one app.


The background verification capability is embedded directly into the employee onboarding workflow. When a new hire is added to SalaryBox, the system can trigger identity and background checks through Compose1 Verify without leaving the platform. The verification results are stored alongside the employee’s attendance records, payroll data, and HR documents. This means your compliance documentation — proof that you verified the employee before or during onboarding — lives in the same system that generates their payslips, tracks their attendance, and manages their leave.


For small and mid-sized businesses that cannot afford to maintain separate software for payroll, attendance, HRMS, and background verification, SalaryBox consolidates everything into a single platform. The ROI calculation is straightforward: instead of paying for four separate tools and managing four separate logins, you pay for one.


The mobile-first design is a significant advantage for businesses with distributed workforces. Store managers, site supervisors, and operations heads can manage attendance, run payroll, and initiate employee verification from their phone. There is no need for a desktop, a VPN, or an IT department.


**Core features:** Attendance (biometric, GPS, facial recognition, QR), payroll automation, HRMS, leave management, shift scheduling, employee document management, integrated BGV via Compose1 Verify


**Pricing model:** Freemium for core HRMS; BGV checks via Compose1 are pay-per-check


**Ideal for:** SMEs, retail chains, restaurants, construction companies, franchises, and any business that wants HR operations and employee verification in one place


## 3. AuthBridge


**Best for:** Enterprise-grade, high-volume screening with the deepest database


AuthBridge is the largest and most established background verification company in India. They have been in the market since 2005 and have built what is arguably the most comprehensive proprietary database in the Indian BGV space. Their platform covers identity, education, employment, criminal records, credit checks, drug testing, social media screening, and global checks across 160+ countries.


For large enterprises with thousands of hires per year and complex multi-country screening requirements, AuthBridge delivers the depth and scale that smaller platforms cannot match. Their Workforce Fraud Files reports are the most cited source of BGV discrepancy statistics in India, which speaks to their data depth.


The trade-off is complexity. AuthBridge is built for enterprise procurement — contracts, account managers, custom SLAs, and integration projects. If you are a 20-person startup that needs to verify three candidates this month, AuthBridge is not built for you.


**Checks offered:** Identity, employment, education, criminal, credit, drug testing, social media, global, directorship, litigation


**Turnaround:** 3–7 days for standard checks; varies for complex packages


**Pricing model:** Contract-based, custom quotes


**Ideal for:** Large enterprises, MNCs, BFSI, and companies with 500+ hires per year


## 4. SpringVerify


**Best for:** Digital-first BGV for fast-growing startups and tech companies


SpringVerify has positioned itself as the modern alternative to traditional BGV agencies. Their platform is designed for tech-savvy HR teams that want API integrations, automated workflows, and real-time status tracking. The candidate experience is smoother than most enterprise providers — candidates receive a link, submit their documents, and the verification runs in the background.


Their education and employment verification processes are well-structured, with clear timelines and proactive updates. The integration with popular ATS and HRMS platforms makes SpringVerify a natural fit for startups and mid-market companies that already have a modern HR tech stack.


**Checks offered:** Identity, employment, education, criminal, address, reference checks


**Turnaround:** 2–5 days for most checks


**Pricing model:** Per-check pricing with volume discounts; some plans require contracts


**Ideal for:** Funded startups, Series A–C companies, and tech-forward HR teams


## 5. IDfy


**Best for:** API-first identity verification and KYC at scale


IDfy specialises in real-time identity verification through APIs — making it particularly strong for companies that need to verify identity at scale within their own applications. Their technology covers face matching, liveness detection, document OCR, and database verification for PAN, Aadhaar, Voter ID, and Driving Licence.


For companies building fintech products, lending platforms, or gig economy apps where identity verification is embedded into the user flow, IDfy’s API approach is hard to beat. For traditional HR teams that want a dashboard and downloadable reports, it may feel more technical than necessary.


**Checks offered:** Identity (API-based), face match, liveness detection, document OCR, criminal, employment, education


**Turnaround:** Seconds for API-based identity checks; days for manual verifications


**Pricing model:** API-based pricing, volume tiers


**Ideal for:** Fintech, NBFC, gig economy platforms, and companies with in-house engineering teams


## 6. OnGrid


**Best for:** Affordable BGV for blue-collar and frontline hiring


OnGrid focuses on a segment that most enterprise BGV companies underserve: blue-collar and frontline workers. Their platform offers quick identity and address verification designed for the pace of frontline hiring, where a delivery driver or warehouse worker needs to start tomorrow, not next week.


The pricing is competitive, and the platform supports bulk verification uploads. The trade-off is that their education and employment verification capabilities are less comprehensive than enterprise providers like AuthBridge or First Advantage.


**Checks offered:** Identity, address, criminal, basic employment, basic education


**Turnaround:** 1–3 days for identity and address; 5–7 days for employment


**Pricing model:** Per-check, competitive rates


**Ideal for:** Logistics companies, delivery platforms, staffing agencies, and high-volume blue-collar hiring


## 7. HireRight


**Best for:** Global companies hiring in India with cross-border screening needs


HireRight is a global screening giant with operations across 200+ countries. For multinational companies that hire in India and need consistent screening standards across all geographies, HireRight provides the global reach and compliance infrastructure that local Indian providers cannot match.


Their India operations include EPFO employment verification, criminal checks, education verification, and address confirmation. The platform integrates with major global ATS platforms. The downside is pricing — HireRight is built for enterprise budgets, and the process is heavier than what a local SME needs.


**Checks offered:** Identity, employment (including EPFO), education, criminal, global screening, drug testing, credit


**Turnaround:** 5–10 days for India-specific checks; varies for global


**Pricing model:** Enterprise contracts, annual commitments


**Ideal for:** MNCs, GCCs, and companies with international hiring across multiple countries


---


## How to Choose: A Quick Decision Framework


- If you need instant identity verification with no contracts → Compose1 Verify
- If you want BGV built into your attendance and payroll system → SalaryBox
- If you need enterprise-scale screening with the deepest database → AuthBridge
- If you want a modern, API-driven platform for tech companies → SpringVerify
- If you need identity APIs embedded into your own product → IDfy
- If you are doing high-volume blue-collar hiring → OnGrid
- If you need cross-border screening for a global workforce → HireRight


The right tool depends on your hiring volume, the depth of checks you need, your budget, and whether you want a standalone verification platform or one that integrates into your broader HR tech stack. For most SMEs and startups in India, the combination of Compose1 Verify for instant identity checks and SalaryBox for integrated HRMS gives you the best coverage without the complexity or cost of enterprise BGV contracts.
